title: Synthesis, characterization, DNA binding interactions, DFT calculations, and Covid-19 molecular docking of novel bioactive copper(I) complexes developed via unexpected reduction of azo-hydrazo ligands.
authors: Elsayed, Eman Hassan; Al-Wahaib, Dhuha; Ali, Ali El-Dissouky; Abd-El-Nabey, Beshir A; Elbadawy, Hemmat A
one_liner_zh: 该文合成铜(I)配合物并研究其与DNA的结合及对接，虽涉及蛋白-DNA互作但非TF-DNA体系，且方法以实验为主、分子对接为辅，与本课题关联有限。
abstract: In this work, we focused on the 3rd goal of the sustainable development plan: achieving good health and supporting well-being. Two redox-active hydrazo ligands namely, phenylcarbonohydrazonoyldicyanide (PCHD) and pyridin-4-ylcarbonohydrazonoyl-dicyanide (PyCHD), and their copper(I) complexes have been synthesized and characterized. The analytical data indicates the formation of copper(I) complexes despite starting with copper(II) perchlorate salt. The (1)H-NMR and UV-visible spectral studies in DMSO revealed that PyCHD mainly exists in its azo-form, while PCHD exists in azo <--> hydrazo equilibrium form, and confirmed the copper(I) oxidation state. XPS, spectral and electrochemistry data indicated the existence of copper(I) valence of both complexes. Cyclic voltammetry of PCHD and its copper(I) complex supported the reduction power of the ligand. The antimicrobial activity, cytotoxicity against the mammalian breast carcinoma cell line (MCF7), and DNA interaction of the compounds are investigated. All compounds showed high antimicrobial, and cytotoxic activities, relative to the standard drugs. Upon studying the wheat DNA binding, PCHD and PyCHD were found to bind through external contacts, while both [Cu(PCHD)(2)]ClO(4).H(2)O and [Cu(PyCHD)(2)]ClO(4).H(2)O were intercalated binding. In-silico molecular docking simulations against Estrogen Receptor Alpha Ligand Binding Domain (ID: 6CBZ) were performed on all produced compounds and confirmed the invitro experimentally best anticancer activity of [Cu(PyCHD)(2)]ClO(4).H(2)O. The molecular docking tests against SARS-CoV-2 main protease (ID: 6 WTT) showed promising activity in the order of total binding energy values: [Cu(PCHD)(2)]ClO(4).H(2)O > [Cu(PyCHD)(2)]ClO(4).H(2)O > PCHD > PyCHD.
abstract_zh: 在本工作中，我们聚焦于可持续发展计划的第三个目标：实现良好健康与支持福祉。我们合成并表征了两种氧化还原活性肼配体，即苯基碳酰肼腙二氰化物（PCHD）和吡啶-4-基碳酰肼腙二氰化物（PyCHD），以及它们的铜(I)配合物。分析数据表明，尽管起始原料为铜(II)高氯酸盐，但形成了铜(I)配合物。在DMSO中的(1)H-NMR和紫外-可见光谱研究表明，PyCHD主要以偶氮形式存在，而PCHD以偶氮<-->腙平衡形式存在，并确认了铜(I)氧化态。XPS、光谱和电化学数据表明两种配合物均存在铜(I)价态。PCHD及其铜(I)配合物的循环伏安法支持了配体的还原能力。研究了化合物的抗菌活性、对哺乳动物乳腺癌细胞系（MCF7）的细胞毒性以及DNA相互作用。所有化合物相对于标准药物均表现出高抗菌和细胞毒性活性。在研究小麦DNA结合时，发现PCHD和PyCHD通过外部接触结合，而[Cu(PCHD)2]ClO(4)·H(2)O和[Cu(PyCHD)2]ClO(4)·H(2)O则通过嵌入方式结合。对所有生成的化合物进行了针对雌激素受体α配体结合域（ID: 6CBZ）的计算机分子对接模拟，并确认了[Cu(PyCHD)2]ClO(4)·H(2)O在体外实验中最佳的抗癌活性。针对SARS-CoV-2主蛋白酶（ID: 6 WTT）的分子对接测试显示，按总结合能值排序的活性顺序为：[Cu(PCHD)2]ClO(4)·H(2)O > [Cu(PyCHD)2]ClO(4)·H(2)O > PCHD > PyCHD。
